_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Tube Failure Report
summary: Provides microwave tube failure information for tracking government furnished equipment tube failures that occur during installation/integration of new production SPY Radar/Fire Control System cabinets at the contractor's facility.
use_relationship:
This report shall provide microwave tube failure information for tracking government furnished equipment (GFE) tube failures that have occurred during installation/integration phase of new production SPY Radar/Fire Control System (FCS) cabinets at the Contractor's facility.

This data item description (DID) contains the format and content preparation instructions for the data product generated by the specific and discrete task requirement for the data included in the contract.

This DID supersedes DI-MNTY-80175.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Format
preparation_instructions.content: The Tube Failure Report shall be in the contractor's format.

preparation_instructions.title: Content
preparation_instructions.content: The report shall contain the following information:

children.title: Government microwave tube nomenclature and serial/Government Part number of failed tube
Disposition of failed tube (e.g., warranty repair, warranty replacement, etc)
Part number and serial number of cabinets and NHA
Failure Mode (General Description of Failure)
children.content: including applicable specification or ATP paragraph number, contributing factors such as coolant or power loss, cabinet faults displayed at time of failure.
